title: POST /internal/match — 200 response, contract version 1
$comment: Contract version 1. Fields are added, never renamed or removed, without bumping the version in $id and title and updating both apps' tests (server: tests/integration/match/endpoint.test.ts; charts: tests/fixtures/contract.test.ts). additionalProperties is false on purpose: an added field must land here first.

serverVersion.description: server/package.json version, plus '+<short git sha>' when the image was built with GIT_SHA.

osvSyncedAt.description: When the OSV mirror was last brought up to date: the latest of the incremental poll, the full refresh and the initial import.

epssScoreDate.description: The FIRST.org score date of the EPSS file last applied.

kevCatalogVersion.description: CISA's catalogVersion of the KEV catalogue last applied.

component.description: Index into the request's components: the primary of the collapsed set.

findingIdentity.description: vulnerabilities.finding_identity: the CVE this is, or '#<vulnId>' when it stands alone.

aliases.description: Every other id the finding is known by, sorted: the OSV aliases of every advisory in the collapsed set plus the folded advisories' own ids. Never contains vulnId.

publishedAt.description: When the advisory was published, per OSV: the earliest 'published' across the collapsed set's records. Null when no record in the set carries one.

risk.description: vulnerabilities.risk_score, the generated column (ADR 0005). Never recomputed by the caller.

packageName.description: The source package for deb / rpm / apk (rule 4 in server/src/db/findings.ts); the component's name otherwise.

purlType.description: The purl type as the matcher normalises it (lower-cased, 'go' → 'golang'); null without a parseable purl.
